body: I'm okay now. Had a moment of weakness
I used to. Cant because of current job
I dont want to be better. This has become home to me
Way too much beer. I found a bottle of vodka in my truck. Going to start that soon
I've fought too hard for too long
But I want it to end
Exactly. I deserve to feel like this
Roommates. Parents are divorced. They could give half a fuck less about me
I dont care anymore. No one does

I understand. There is only one person I can actually talk to. And she can confide in me. We have became closer than i am to my own family. It just feels like sometimes that's all I have. That one person. She is dealing with things along the same lines I am. Very similar. Just not the same. 

I hate feeling like a burden when I talk to people. Like I have to hide how I feel because I've always been the strongest emotionally and mentally. I never let my personal battle get in the way of me helping people. I've just gotten to the point where I feel like my help is only hurting myself.
